name: Neothesia
title: Neothesia: free Synthesia alternative
job: Shows you which keys to play
caption:
Synthesia costs $39 to learn piano songs from falling notes. Neothesia does it for free 🎹

✅ Turns any MIDI song into colorful falling notes on a virtual piano
✅ Plug in a MIDI keyboard and play along
✅ Choose a track to mute, auto-play or play yourself
✅ Slow the song down and rewind while you practice

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux
ℹ️ You bring your own MIDI files (no built-in song library), and playing along needs a MIDI keyboard. On Mac, right-click the app and choose Open the first time. Synthesia's regular price is $39 (it's sometimes on sale)

Comment "PIANO" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

dm_pitch: Neothesia, the free open-source Synthesia alternative for learning piano 🎹

beats.say: Strangers on the internet rebuilt Synthesia, and gave it away for free.
Wait, the falling notes piano app?
Synthesia charges thirty nine dollars. Neothesia costs nothing.
Load any MIDI song, and the notes fall onto the keys you need to play.
Plug in a keyboard, and pick which parts you play and which it plays for you.
Slow it down, rewind, and pick your own piano sound.
It's Synthesia, without the price tag.
Comment Piano, and I'll send you the link.
